title: Quarantine
intro: Events that could not be normalized (e.g. content not matching the decoder, corrupted XML) or written – with the original and the reason. After fixing the decoder (

) or the program you can reprocess them: recovered events go to the database and detection like new ones (with the siem.quarantined_at field), and entries that still fail get the current reason. The NIS2 archive has the originals from the start – nothing is archived twice.
noNats: The panel is not connected to NATS – reprocessing is unavailable (preview works).
empty: The quarantine is empty in the selected period.
entries: Latest entries ({{count}}) – click to see the original

entry.unsupportedTip: Entry rejected when writing to ClickHouse or from the replay path – it cannot be reprocessed

confirm.title: Reprocess quarantine
confirm.text: Entries: {{what}}. The normalizer processes them with the current code and decoders. Recovered events go to the database and detection (they may raise alerts); already recovered entries are skipped. At most 10,000 entries per job.

wizardTitle: Decoder wizard – mark the fields in the quarantined messages
decoderSaved: Decoder saved – now reprocess the group
